messages.text:
Can you build Neon Pairs from the supplied product specification? Please implement the whole game, including its board codes, saved snapshots and replay command. Use the documented build and test commands and give me the offline dist/index.html. Keep the code arranged as the Architecture document says. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Implemented Neon Pairs, including reproducible board codes, snapshot import/export, saved preferences and best scores, keyboard controls, and the replay CLI.

The offline build is [dist/index.html](/work/dist/index.html) (245,458 bytes). The Playwright journeys confirmed it opens from disk without HTTP requests.

Verification passed: `npm ci`, type check, 24 unit tests, 7 browser journeys, and build. Tested with Node 26.12.1, npm 11.20.0, Playwright 1.64.1, and Chromium 156.0.8078.4.

Automated accessibility-tree captures are in [docs/accessibility-tree-evidence.md](/work/docs/accessibility-tree-evidence.md). No screen reader was used during developer testing.
